biochemWork.title: Factory work · who does what today
biochemWork.subtitle: One person can hold several duties. Work is assigned to people, and each job is checked against what that person already did on the same batch.
biochemWork.noRight: You can see the duty board but not assign work. Ask Admin for the production edit right.

load.title: People on duty · {{date}}
load.emptyTitle: Nobody assigned yet for this date
load.emptyBody: Assign the day's duties below; each job goes to the person's own screen.

assign.title: Assign a duty
assign.noPeople: Only Admin can see the full list of people; otherwise people already on the duty board are shown.

checks.title: Checks when work is assigned
checks.same: Same person, same batch: whoever made, weighed, issued or packed a batch can't be its QC releaser, and its QC releaser can't help make it.
checks.role: Only someone with a role in this company can be given work.
checks.started: A making duty stays on record once the batch has started; it can't be removed.
checks.logged: Who assigned what to whom, and when, is kept in the transaction log.
